entries.title: Proverbs 19:1
segments: Better [is] the poor who walks in his integrity than he who [is] perverse in his lips, and is a fool.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:2
segments: Also without knowledge the soul [is] not good, and he who hurries with his feet sins.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:3
segments: The foolishness of man perverts his way, and his heart frets against the LORD.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:4
segments: Wealth makes many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbor.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:5
segments: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and a breather of lies shall not escape.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:6
segments: Many will beg the favor of a ruler, and all [are] friends to a man who gives gifts.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:7
segments: All the brothers of the poor man hate him; how much more do his friends go far from him? He pursues [them] with words, yet they [are] lacking.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:8
segments: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul; he who keeps understanding shall find good.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:9
segments: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and one speaking lies shall perish.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:10
segments: Luxury is not becoming for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:11
segments: The judgment of a man puts off his anger; and [it is] his glory to pass over a transgression.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:12
segments: The king's wrath [is] like the roaring of a lion; but his favor [is] like dew on the grass.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:13
segments: A foolish son [is] ruin to his father, and the quarreling of a wife [is] a never-ending dripping.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:14
segments: Houses and riches [are] the inheritance of fathers, and a prudent wife [is] from the LORD.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:15
segments: Laziness throws one into a deep sleep, and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:16
segments: He who keeps the commandment keeps his own soul; he who despises His ways shall die.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:17
segments: He who has pity upon the poor lends to the LORD, and He will reward his dealing to him.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:18
segments: Chasten your son while there is hope, and do not set your soul on making him die.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:19
segments: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment; for if you deliver [him] yet you must do it again.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:20
segments: Hear advice, and receive instruction, so that you may be wise in your latter end.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:21
segments: [There are] many purposes in a man's heart, but the counsel of the LORD shall stand.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:22
segments: The charm of a man [is] his kindness, and a poor man [is] better than a liar.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:23
segments: The fear of the LORD [tends] to life, and he rests satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:24
segments: A lazy one puts his hand in a dish, and he will not return it to his mouth.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:25
segments: Strike a scorner, and the simple will beware; reprove one who has understanding, and he will understand knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:26
segments: He who assaults his father [and] chases away his mother [is] a son who causes shame and brings reproach.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:27
segments: My son, cease to hear the discipline, [only] to stray from the words of knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:28
segments: An ungodly witness scorns judgment, and the mouth of the wicked devours iniquity.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:29
segments: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.
